name: American Cockroach Walk Cycle
author: BONOMI STUDIO
notes: Realistic American cockroach (Periplaneta americana) with a walk-cycle animation ('Modelo Cucaracha'). Skinned, 46 bone joints (Bone001_..Bone0xx_xx naming), 8 materials, 24 embedded textures (PBR-style Substance export). Good crawl candidate; under the 60k-face limit at ~4.1k tris. Scale unknown: check and normalize after loading.

name: Cockroach
author: CK
notes: Cockroach with a single skinned armature (roach.fbx: spine_03, hip_00, head, tail, 6-leg chains) and one 'Take 001' animation (likely a crawl/idle, not verified). ~29.5k tris, 1 material, 3 textures. Less polished than the BONOMISTUDIO model (appearance is a simpler look). Good as a second variant for crowd variety. Scale unknown.
